high_level_description: The image depicts a formal interview or discussion setting. Two individuals are seated on white armchairs with gold accents, facing each other across a small wooden table. The person on the left is holding a microphone and appears to be speaking, while the person on the right is listening attentively. The background features a geometric patterned wall in white and light gray tones, adding a modern and clean aesthetic to the scene. On either side of the individuals, there are small wooden side tables with a vase containing a bouquet of flowers and a blue bottle, possibly water, placed on them.
